governance.register_state_caveat: Existing PA-R records remain research records; coordinator must put implementation assignments and activation states in the central register/dispatch. This handoff itself does not activate jobs.
governance.central_owner: Root/coordinator owns shared manifests, controller/registry changes, integration and the serialized Cargo/check lease.

capacity.rule: Use fewer workers whenever contracts or canonical outputs contend; never parallelize edits to shared state.

model_routing.basis: Available session capability descriptions; no exact price or cost ratio is asserted.
model_routing.gpt-6-luna: Low/medium metadata, notices, inventory, source-range/pin reconciliation, straightforward isolated mechanics.
model_routing.gpt-6.1-sol: Medium for stable isolated implementation; high for native UI, domain state, authority/session behavior, integration and independent review.
model_routing.gpt-6-astra: Escalation only for a concrete unresolved architecture question with evidence and a bounded decision request.

waves.name: material motion and native controls
waves.worker_count_guidance: 1-2 only after exact path allowlists; coordinator may run it serially if controller/state edits contend.
deliverables: authorized UI/MCP route through same domain operation
exit_evidence: fresh-process HMC reopen preserves editable keys/resources
coordinator executed checks and remaining human acceptance recorded

waves.name: selected image, texture and effect stack
deliverables: one small supported image/reference to editable layer/property/effect path
reuse audited Photo/Effect operations and existing Qualia operators
native and authorized agent route to the same document revision
exclusions: unsupported scripts/plugins treated as successful import
new app shell or hidden document store

waves.name: plant graph/organ and animal rig/weight/native preview bindings
worker_tracks: connected animal mesh/rig/weight/clip admission and preview
deliverables: bounded selection/edit/preview artifacts with exact source and correspondence
reuse of canonical QualiaDB geometry/simulation/skeletal/upload owners
waves.dependency_note: Wait only on each relevant shared contract; full compositor completion is not a dependency. Engineering preview is not biological acceptance.

waves.name: integrated cooperative qualification and game-demo derivative path
deliverables: Native contributor work and a separately admitted reviewer context, plus an agent operating under its own grants on the same source; actual human/domain approval recorded separately.
coherent handoff of open model and human/domain claims
reference-readiness evidence map with open model acceptance IDs
waves.stage_boundary: IP-03 authoring qualification precedes IP-04/05 master/complete package acceptance; IP-06 derivative use follows. With asset production HOLD, W4 can deliver software/readiness evidence only; it cannot create or accept final masters or assert completed game-demo use.

separately_scheduled_product_work.constraint: Remain explicit Poet work; schedule by coherent interface/case, not as all-suite prerequisites to first master.

handoff_minimum: existing IP/ECO/PA/BS/R IDs and actual user/agent operation
exact immutable inputs and preimage hashes
disjoint owned paths and forbidden shared paths
dependencies and actual Poet/QualiaDB caller example
accepted/refused operation outcomes and evidence owner
model/reasoning effort and task-based route reason
changed path hashes, result/history/reopen artifacts, open cases, next bounded action

failure_and_cost_policy.failure: Capture the reproducer once and repair only owned scope. If a focused repair fails or the same failure repeats, stop repeating that approach and escalate to the coordinator for repair or rescoping; the dependent gate remains failed until resolved.
failure_and_cost_policy.escalation: Astra only for a specific unresolved architecture question. Unclear permission/contract blocks only its dependent slice; continue independent work.
failure_and_cost_policy.usage: Record observed usage/cost data, retries and tool/compute charges when available; mark unknown if unavailable. No unmeasured time/token/dollar estimates or savings promises.
failure_and_cost_policy.worker_checks: Workers may author focused checks within their files; only coordinator runs Cargo/workspace checks under serial lease and freezes source during a check.

external_planning_references.use: Independent work boundaries, clear outputs, dependent steps kept with coordinator.
Usage accounting includes root/subagents/retries and recorded usage may be best-effort rather than a final bill.

launch_sequence: The linked plan contains per-wave worker lanes and launch conditions. Freeze exact source/symbol allowlists in the existing register before each launch. Four waves may include correction rounds; no four-turn/time/cost promise or background launcher.
